description: Models for a task and memory budget. provenOnly can return tested commands and a signed proof receipt when enabled. Use when the user states RAM or VRAM and needs model recommendations, not fine-tuning. Example: {"task":"chat","hardware":"8gb-laptop"}. Download is not run proof. provenOnly needs exact hardware and a run under 24 hours old. Read no-match reasons and retry guidance.

commercial.description: True to require recorded permission for commercial use.

detail.description: Summary rows by default; full returns detailed rows. Large results include bounded previews and detail links.

hardware.description: Free text or preset for estimates. For provenOnly use an exact class: e2-8gb, e2-16gb, e2-32gb, c3-16gb, c3-32gb, apple-m2-16gb, rtx3060-12, rtx4060-8 or rtx4090-24. Generic memory never matches a measured class. No default.

model.description: Model name or owner/repo to check first; alternatives are labelled explicitly.

os.description: Client OS for the tested local server handoff when enabled.

provenOnly.description: Require a fresh signed run on the exact hardware class. Returns testedRunPlan commands and receiptCard evidence, or no recommendation. Requires the proven finder feature.

ramGb.description: System RAM in GB; use instead of hardware or gpu.

task.description: Task the model or service should perform.
